method: Visually inspected all 32 overview pages at their natural thumbnail resolution. Inspected source and enlarged proof sheets for detected defects. After the final rear-bag and girl-wide-trouser mask changes, rechecked affected geometry in final close-up proofs and final canonical overview pages. Final file hashes below identify the audited output.
checks: Waist and hip proportions across every bottom versus all tops and jackets
Continuous trouser skinning through both walk extremes
Shirt torso closure and sleeve ownership without jackets
Bag pouch placement with rear straps hidden by torso and sleeves
Shoe/hem attachment and visible accessory depth
resolvedFindings: Short-shirt side panels previously rotated as sleeves; corrected painted armpit boundaries and cuff limit
Hatted ponytail previously had a flat horizontal chop; now occluded by actual hat alpha
Rear bag strap previously left a small shoulder nub; now clipped to torso interior
Girl wide-trouser split sampled opposite-leg strip; divider now follows transparent leg gap
